WITH excluded_ids AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory 
  WHERE "U-PRO" = '-' AND ID IS NOT NULL
),
step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    l.ID,
    p.SEX,
    AVG(l.PT) as avg_pt,
    AVG(CAST(l.ALP AS REAL) / l.GPT) as avg_ratio
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM excluded_ids)
  GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX
)
SELECT 
  SEX,
  AVG(avg_pt) as avg_pt_overall,
  AVG(avg_ratio) as avg_ratio_overall
FROM step1
GROUP BY SEX
